entries.title: Matthew 17:1
segments: Six days later Jesus took with him Peter and James and his brother John, and led them up a high mountain, by themselves apart.

entries.title: Matthew 17:2
segments: Here he was transfigured before them; his face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

entries.title: Matthew 17:3
segments: And behold! Moses and Elijah appeared to them, talking with Jesus.

entries.title: Matthew 17:4
segments: Then Peter said to Jesus: "Master, it is good that we are here! If you are willing I will make here three tents, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."

entries.title: Matthew 17:5
segments: While he was yet speaking, behold! a luminous cloud overshadowed them; and a voice out of the cloud, saying: "This is my Son, my Beloved, in whom is my delight. Listen to him."

entries.title: Matthew 17:6
segments: When the disciples heard this, they fell on their faces and were terrified.

entries.title: Matthew 17:7
segments: But Jesus came to them and touched them, saying, "Rise, have no fear!"

entries.title: Matthew 17:8
segments: And when they raised their eyes they saw no one save Jesus only.

entries.title: Matthew 17:9
segments: While they were going down from the mountain, Jesus laid a command on them: "Speak to no man about the vision," he said, "until after the Son of man has been raised from the dead."

entries.title: Matthew 17:10
segments: And his disciples asked him, saying, "Why then do the Scribes say that Elijah must first come?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:11
segments: And he answered: "Elijah is coming, and will restore all things.

entries.title: Matthew 17:12
segments: "Nay, I say to you that Elijah has come already, and they did not recognize him, but did to him whatever they chose. Even so the Son of man also is about to suffer at their hands."

entries.title: Matthew 17:13
segments: Then the disciples divined that he had been speaking to them about John, the Baptist.

entries.title: Matthew 17:14
segments: As they reached the crowd, a man came up to Jesus, and fell on his knees before him, saying:

entries.title: Matthew 17:15
segments: "Master, take pity on my son, for he is an epileptic and sore distressed. Often he falls into the fire and often into the water.

entries.title: Matthew 17:16
segments: "And I brought him to your disciples, but they could not cure him."

entries.title: Matthew 17:17
segments: In reply Jesus said: "O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I endure you? Bring him here to me!"

entries.title: Matthew 17:18
segments: Then Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, and it came out of him; and the boy was cured from that very hour.

entries.title: Matthew 17:19
segments: Thereupon Jesus' disciples came to him and asked him privately, "Why were we not able to cast it out?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:20
segments: "Because of your little faith," he answered. "In solemn truth I tell you that if you have faith the size of a mustard-seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from this place to that!' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible to you.

entries.title: Matthew 17:21
segments: "But this kind is driven out by prayer alone."

entries.title: Matthew 17:22
segments: As they continued going from place to place in Galilee, Jesus said to them: "The Son of man is about to be betrayed into the hands of men;

entries.title: Matthew 17:23
segments: "and they will kill him, but on the third day he will rise again." And they were greatly grieved.

entries.title: Matthew 17:24
segments: As they came into Capernaum the collectors of the temple tax came to Peter and asked, "Does not your Teacher pay the temple tax?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:25
segments: "Indeed he does," answered Peter. But on Peter's entering the house, Jesus forestalled him, saying: "How does it seem to you, Simon? From whom do earthly kings collect customs or taxes-from their own people, or from aliens?"

entries.title: Matthew 17:26
segments: And when he replied, "From aliens," Jesus said: "Then their people go free.

entries.title: Matthew 17:27
segments: "Nevertheless, that we may not give offense, go to the seaside, throw in your hook; take the first fish that rises, and when you have opened its mouth, you will find a shekel in it. Take it and give it to them for us both."
